description: MEASURED CEILINGS, GRAPH-RESIDENT.  Arc 6 measured five ceilings and killed three seams; every one of those results existed only in markdown the agent cannot read, so a goal-selection collapse would re-propose a refuted seam with no memory.  This seed holds each refutation as a GoalResidual{goal signature, honest AND cherry-picked ceiling, refutation mechanism, reachability class, evidence pointer + engine sha} together with the CONDITION under which it holds (ResidualCondition, holds_under) -- because a residual that cannot lapse is a lie with a long half-life.  A held residual contributes a strong NEGATIVE WEIGHT to the existing ps_move_select Argmax; it is never a veto.  Pursuing an unreachable goal is legitimate -- that is how residuals get made; being wrong where the residual is already held is not.  Every node below is emitted mechanically from results/arc6_*.json by tools/build_goal_residual_seed.py over domains/goal_residual_ingest.py -- no number is transcribed from prose.

microtheory.name: goal_residuals
microtheory.description: held refutations of goals, with their conditions, as a weight in the goal collapse.

attrs.mechanism: tasks unlockable by minting ONE BESPOKE KERNEL PER TASK, named after that task's own concept (octagonal(), perrin_sum(), newman_prime(), area_polygon(), ...). This is the number a per-task mapping would report, and it is FAKE: the oracle table would encode the test-split answers.

attrs.why: the measurement artifact this residual quotes is still on disk with the content sha it was ingested at; a re-measurement replaces it and this residual must be re-read, not re-used.

attrs.mechanism: a cue word in the prose says nothing about whether the grammar can MEAN the task; level 2 is the same population screened by execution.

attrs.why: as above -- the artifact is the evidence; if it changes the ceiling must be re-read.

attrs.mechanism: Even a genuine recognition supplies only a LABEL: the ShapeSignature nodes carry name/kind/concept/faculty/signature and nothing else. No constraint, no relaxation family, no IR template. A label with no payload cannot change what the enumerator does.

attrs.why: the codebook this ceiling was measured against holds exactly six `kind=math` ShapeSignature nodes (ceiling_c_math_shape_codebook.codebook.counts_by_kind). Add or remove one and the measurement no longer describes the codebook -- re-measure.

not one of those shapes carries a `keywords` payload (codebook_carries_a_synthesis_payload = false; a genuine recognition would supply only a LABEL). Give any math shape a keyword payload and the null's own mechanism is gone.

attrs.mechanism: Arc6 Seam D discriminating measurement. Seam D's 36/36 headline is authoring-bound (one PropertyAtom per residual task, scored on that same population). M1 LEAVE-ONE-OUT is the decisive number: it is what survives when a task's OWN atom is removed. Every figure here is a paired id list, never a bare count.

attrs.why: the LOO measurement is the evidence; a re-authored atom set replaces it.

attrs.mechanism: every bundle number above is an INVENTORY ceiling: it counts tasks whose required PRIMITIVES would all exist. It is NOT a claim that the enumerator would FIND the composition.

attrs.why: the op-table inventory is the evidence; widening the enumerator changes the inventory and this ceiling must be re-measured.

attrs.mechanism: Python list and Python tuple are BOTH Value::Tuple in this substrate, verified live: a node attr set to [1,2,3] reads back as (1,2,3).  Set and dict are NOT collapsed (Value::Set / Value::Dict are distinct).  So the ONLY values the collapse can equate are two sequences with IDENTICAL elements and different container types -- it can never equate two different element sequences.

attrs.why: `type_collapse.mechanism`: a node attr set to [1,2,3] reads back as (1,2,3).  The 12 false accepts are a consequence of that and of nothing else.  Distinguish List from Tuple in the value layer and this refutation no longer applies -- which is exactly what arc C of results/arc6_valuelayer.json did on engine 8311d4356082 (NOT the engine in this tree).

rules.name: gr_condition_lapse
rules.comment: A RESIDUAL WHOSE CONDITION NO LONGER HOLDS GOES STALE.  A residual without its condition is precisely the failure CLAUDE.md retracts -- a claim quoted without its condition, which stood false for ten days.  Every GoalResidual carries at least one ResidualCondition (holds_under); this rule reads the LIVE graph for each and marks the residual stale the moment any one of them mismatches.  Staleness is not falsity: it means the measurement no longer describes the world and must be re-made before it may be used again.  Idempotent (guarded on stale!=1) and reversible (gr_condition_hold is the other direction, so a condition that comes back restores the residual -- a latch would be a second un-lapsable claim).

rules.name: gr_condition_hold
rules.comment: The reverse direction, and it is not decoration: a one-way lapse would itself be a claim that cannot be revised.  A stale residual whose conditions ALL hold again is restored to the pool.  Mutually exclusive with gr_condition_lapse by construction (Exists mismatch vs Not Exists mismatch), so the two never contend for the same node in one pass.

rules.name: gr_move_penalty
rules.comment: AUDIT STAMP.  Writes onto the candidate the weight the strongest matching held residual contributes -- the same auditability ps_move_sel_kind/ps_move_sel_gap already provide for the other terms.  The COLLAPSE does not depend on this attr: ps_move_select computes the same penalty INLINE inside its Argmax, so the selection can never be wrong because a stamp had not been written yet in the fixpoint.  Self-extinguishing (it declines to rewrite a value already equal).

rules.name: gr_move_penalty_clear
rules.comment: The other direction of the same stamp: a candidate no held residual speaks to carries an explicit ZERO, so 'no penalty' is a written fact rather than an absent attr.  This is the both-directions discipline -- a stamp that only ever writes non-zero cannot be distinguished from a stamp that never fires.

rules.name: gr_move_sel_audit
rules.comment: WHAT THE WINNER WAS CHARGED.  ps_move_select computes the residual penalty INLINE (so the collapse never depends on stamp ordering) and therefore does not write it down; this rule reads the selected candidate back by its own ps_move_sel_key and copies its residual_penalty onto the goal, giving the residual term the same audit trail ps_move_sel_gap / ps_move_sel_mdl already have.  A selection you cannot read is a selection you cannot check.
